Life is full of small surprises. Owen hopes to visit Chengdu one day. Last Saturday, Owen and Lily went to the class meeting. For example, old friends sometimes drift apart.
They took many photos at the club room. Owen drinks water after doing sports. The weather was cloudy that day. My bad — I read the date wrong.
Lily's birthday is in June. Owen usually has rice for breakfast. Owen thinks history is interesting but a little difficult. Also, save the date for the wedding.
Both of them like rice and water. Owen and Lily had great fun there. It takes twenty minutes to get to the class meeting by bike.
